timecoded_text_to_speech.text: Hi, my name is Richard Roberts. I was awarded the Nobel Prize in Medicine in 1993.
I will be giving the keynote to Grecia Tinargo's forthcoming conference entitled See the Future.
I plan to share some of my experiences and thoughts on how I see the future shaping up for career scientists.
I hope to see some of you at the conference next month and I look forward to any questions you may have.

Our Keynote speaker for the #SeeTheFuture virtual conference is Nobel Laureate Sir Richard J. Roberts, who will discuss the path to Nobel Prize and what future field-changing research will mean for today’s researcher.
